items.title: Ausify Campaign Returns as Australian Music's Streaming Share Hits New Low
items.summary: Ben Lee, Missy Higgins and Budjerah back a month-long campaign urging fans to publicly support Australian music as its streaming share falls.

items.title: Marty Erlichman, Barbra Streisand's Longtime Manager, Dies at 97
items.summary: Barbra Streisand's manager of more than six decades, who discovered her at 19, has died at age 97.

items.summary: Detroit producer Juan Atkins, who pioneered techno as a solo artist and with Cybotron and the Belleville Three, has died at 64.

items.title: Maryland Is Getting Its Own (Mini) Sphere

items.title: UMG's share price closes up 7.9% after Q3 subscription growth beats forecasts

items.title: Copyright Alliance calls Meta's proposed business terms 'unconscionable'
